players.product: Large-scale liquid-cooled AI data-center campuses (Polaris Forge / Delta Forge)

connects_to.relationship: Polaris Forge 1 — 400 MW dedicated AI data-center campus leased to CoreWeave (North Dakota)

contracts.signal: The 10-Q describes the three CoreWeave leases at Polaris Forge 1: the Building 2 lease covers the full capacity of a 100 MW data center that is operational; the Building 3 lease covers a 150 MW data center under construction and expected to become operational during calendar year 2026; the Building 4 lease (August 28, 2025) adds 150 MW, bringing capacity under contract at Polaris Forge 1 to 400 MW, with Building 4 in the design phase and expected to be service-ready in the middle of calendar year 2027.
contracts.units: 400 MW under contract at Polaris Forge 1 (Building 3 150 MW; Building 4 150 MW)
